summary: This is a Form 6-K filing by U Power Ltd announcing the cancellation of an Extraordinary General Meeting of shareholders that was scheduled to consider increasing authorized share capital, adopting amended articles of association, and a share consolidation. The board resolved to cancel the meeting, and no new meeting date or alternative proposal is stated. No offer, transaction, or strategic change is disclosed—only a corporate housekeeping cancellation. What to watch: whether the company later reschedules the meeting or revisits the capital structure changes.
